name: 2-methylundecane
description: 2-Methylundecane (CAS 7045-71-8 ) is a branched-chain alkane used as a solvent carrier and lubricant base component across industrial and specialty chemical applications. Its branched structure supports controlled viscosity profiles and low-temperature performance. In lubricant and metalworking fluids, this compound functions as a base fluid component or diluent, contributing to film formation and reduced friction in cutting and machining operations. It is valued for its stability in high-stress environments. Automotive formulations use it as a carrier solvent in fuel additives and specialty lubricant blends where controlled evaporation and compatibility with hydrocarbon systems are required. This ensures consistent performance in engine systems. Printing and packaging manufacturers incorporate it into ink formulations and release coatings where solvent balance and substrate compatibility are critical to print quality. It helps maintain the integrity of the final printed product. In personal care, it acts as a lightweight emollient carrier in anhydrous and oil-phase formulations, improving spreadability without heavy residue. This makes it an ideal choice for sophisticated cosmetic and skin care applications. The product is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes. Technical grade is the primary commercial specification for most industrial buyers. Purity levels are typically at 98% or higher depending on the specific supplier and manufacturing process. Bulk availability may vary by region, and buyers should confirm specification sheets for trace impurity profiles. Quality control ensures that the material meets the necessary standards for industrial use.
